owner_and_source: TIDES-transit community (github.com/TIDES-transit/TIDES) -- Transit ITS Data Exchange Specification, the open standard for demand-responsive / paratransit trip-level operational data
license_and_commercial_rights: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE); commercial use permitted with attribution and license notice retained
time_coverage: n/a (schema + sample fixtures, not a time series)
schema_and_format: CSV sample of the TIDES trips_performed table -- real trip-level rows in the demand-responsive-transport standard, directly on-point for the paratransit request-to-outcome chain Milexium's ServiceRequest models
update_frequency: spec revisions (versioned via git tags upstream)
canonical_contract: packages.canonical.entities.ServiceRequest (TIDES trips -> ServiceRequest is a future Connect adapter, MX-B-TIDES-ADAPTER)
acceptance_threshold: file downloads and is non-empty; it is a reference spec, not a metric-bearing dataset
retention_and_deletion: retain as part of the standards-adapter certification corpus; cheaply reproducible (re-fetchable from upstream) so evictable first
